summary: Sets or clears the visibility flag bit (0x40) on a scene render node's flag DWORD. Loads the render node pointer from this[129] (this+0x204), reads the flag DWORD at node+0x14 (this+0x218), then ORs 0x40 when a2 is non-zero or ANDs ~0x40 when a2 is zero, returning the node pointer. No guard, no callee; on the per-frame path and driven by scene/AI callers.

local_names.this: scene object holding the render node pointer
local_names.node: scene render node reached via this[129]
local_names.a2: visibility toggle; non-zero sets bit 0x40, zero clears it

operations.description: Load the scene render node pointer from this[129] (this+0x204)
Read the current flag DWORD at node+0x14 (this+0x218) into v3
Branch on the boolean parameter a2: non-zero sets the visibility bit, zero clears it
When a2 is non-zero, write v3 | 0x40 back to node+0x14 (this+0x218), marking the node visible
When a2 is zero, write v3 & 0xFFFFFFBF back to node+0x14 (this+0x218), clearing the visibility bit
Return the scene render node pointer
